SE facts confirmed from Day 7 update text: duchies 4 and 8 were rebalanced for SE (field repositioning); duchies 9 and 10 are new, never published before; all come in 4 copies (20 double-sided boards). Fixed duchy composition (from community-verified constraint, burgundicer): brown/city=12, yellow/monastery=6, blue/water=6, green/pasture=6, red/castle=4, gray/mine=3. Access method: gamefound.com SSR HTML pages fetchable with browser-like headers via python urllib (403 on first try, succeeds on retries); full update list via POST https://gamefound.com/api/projectUpdates/searchProjectUpdates {"projectID":1926,...}; imgcdn.gamefound.com serves full-resolution originals without authentication. Extraction pipeline (ruler-zones + overlay circles + die/terrain montages) produced per-row consensus data for board 1 but failed the 37-cell and color-distribution invariants, so per contract no cell data is asserted.
